title: Kilagen capability vocabulary
description: program/model/capabilities.yml — one file for the whole program. A capability is the menu of what a security program can build and the facet that groups documents by domain. It carries no assessment: no maturity, no coverage, no systems list.

id.description: Namespaced as <domain>.<capability>, which makes it unique across the program by construction

domain.description: Must match the id's prefix and exist in domains.yml

why.description: Why a program would build this
